title: Self-contained Schnorr gate elimination: (2, 1) for the MOD-3 family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total MOD-3 family defined in proof.md Section 1: for every integer n>=0 and x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x)=1 iff the number of ones in x is congruent to 0 mod 3 (so f_0=1 on the empty string). One linear-time algorithm keeping a counter mod 3 evaluates it at every length; the NP verifier is V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and that algorithm accepts x, with witness bound W(n)=0.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 for EVERY integer n>=2 at actual input length n=|x| in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model (self-contained Schnorr-style gate elimination in proof.md), hence C_B2(f_n)>=2n-o(n) and liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=2.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: Unscored lemma (proof.md Theorem 6.1): for every integer m>=2 and every residue r in {0,1,2}, every circuit in the model of proof.md Section 3 (two-pin gates with any of the 16 binary truth tables, unrestricted fan-out and depth, repeated pins allowed, zero-cost constant nodes, any node as output) that computes M^m_r(x)=1 iff x_1+...+x_m is congruent to r mod 3 has at least 2m-3 gates.
